disorder-name.detail: Aggregate schizophrenia group (all SCZ; n=168) combining 4 sub-cohorts: HCP EP Early SCZ (DSM-V nonaffective psychosis within 5 years of onset, n=83), UCLA SCZ (DSM-IV schizophrenia or schizoaffective, n=41), SCZ+AH (DSM-V schizophrenia or schizoaffective with daily auditory verbal hallucinations, n=21), SCZ-AH (DSM-V schizophrenia or schizoaffective without hallucinations, n=23)
disorder-name.supporting_text: "One hundred sixty-eight participants (43 female, 125 male) from the 4 SCZ phenotypes were included in the aggregate SCZ group (all SCZ)."

dataset-of-origin.detail: HCP-EP contributed Early SCZ (n=83; nonaffective psychosis within 5 years of onset); UCLA-LA5c contributed UCLA SCZ (n=41; schizophrenia/schizoaffective per DSM-IV, OpenNeuro ds000030); SCZ AH study (OpenNeuro ds004302; Soler-Vidal et al. 2022) contributed SCZ+AH (n=21) and SCZ-AH (n=23) — this last study is a single-site study not otherwise listed in the keyword table, coded as SINGLE-SITE
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "Unprocessed T1-weighted images and clinical measures were accessed from 7 cohorts (HCP DEV, HCP EP, HCP YA, UCLA, SCZ AH, HCP AGE, and ADNI)"

age.detail: Weighted mean and pooled SD derived from the 4 SCZ sub-cohort statistics in Table 2: HCP EP Early SCZ (n=83, mean=22.2, SD=3.1), UCLA SCZ (n=41, mean=36.0, SD=9.0), SCZ+AH (n=21, mean=39.7, SD=13.5), SCZ-AH (n=23, mean=45.0, SD=7.4). Weighted mean=(83×22.2+41×36.0+21×39.7+23×45.0)/168=30.88 years (weighted). Pooled SD=sqrt([(82×9.61)+(40×81.0)+(20×182.25)+(22×54.76)]/(168−4))=7.36 (pooled). Min=16.7 and Max=66.0 are the extremes across all sub-cohorts.
